text: BAM share fell 0.03 percentage points over 25 hours but is up 1.5 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 34.3% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.2% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes should be read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
